records.scope: Flask application implementing the sourceforge.net mirror: home with Project of the Month picks and popular projects, open source directory with token-scored search, facet filters (os/topic/license/language/audience/environment/translation/devstatus) and sort orders, per-facet browse pages, project summary with rating stars and Additional Project Details, file browser with per-folder/per-file pages and download interstitial, reviews with histogram and star filters plus review submission, support hub, wiki, four ticket trackers with search/status/priority filters and ticket discussion, forums with thread pages, news feed, activity feed, download statistics (timeline/OS/country map), top-downloaded tables, business software directory (categories, product pages), about/leadership, user profiles, auth (username-or-email login, registration, profile edit), account area (bookmarks, my reviews), site-wide 404, and /_health.

Deterministic build-time seeder. All content rows come from the tracked source_data/ snapshots (Allura REST project metadata, wayback directory cards, 7-Zip deep-scrape JSON, top-download tables, real review pages); benchmark users use a frozen bcrypt hash so the SQLite seed is byte-reproducible on every build (PYTHONHASHSEED=0).

411 project records: 262 from the Allura REST API (rest/p/<name>: summary, creation date, taxonomy, tools, developers) captured 2026-09-25/26, and 149 from Wayback Machine directory-page snippets (title/subtitle/description/downloads/reviews) for projects whose REST endpoint was rate-limited; shortnames normalized (the internal .mirror harvest suffix was stripped).
395 directory result-card rows (downloads this week, review counts, last-updated labels) parsed from the captured sourceforge.net directory pages.

The real all-time top-20 and weekly top-20 download tables (project shortname -> download count) parsed from the captured /top page; these exact numbers back the mirror's Top Downloaded Projects tables and the seeded download totals for those 40 projects.

The 35 tickets in 7-Zip's Bugs tracker (numbers, summaries, statuses, creators, owners, priorities, dates) and the full discussion posts for tickets 2701 and 2692, captured from the upstream tracker pages.
50 forum threads across 7-Zip's Open Discussion and Help forums (subjects, creators, dates, post/view counts) plus the Dark Mode thread's posts, captured from the upstream forum pages.
The 75 most recent 7-Zip reviews (authors, dates, star ratings, full texts) captured from the upstream reviews page.

Real review pages for seven more projects (keepass, portableapps, crystaldiskinfo, audacity, qbittorrent, ventoy, mpv-player-windows): ~19-25 latest reviews each plus their real rating summaries and histograms.

50 Wayback Machine captures of sourceforge.net pages (home, directory, project summary/files/reviews/stats, trackers, forums, top, software directory, about, leadership, auth, register) used as the structural reference for templates and the source of the top-download tables and UI asset URLs.
Raw Allura REST JSON responses per project (rest/p/<name>) captured 2026-09-25/26.

Harvest working records: icon_urls.txt / shot_urls.txt (upstream a.fsdn.com media URL -> local file mapping backing asset_inventory.json source_url fields), image_manifest.json (path -> source URL), and retry logs.

Tracked manifest of all 1069 managed media files under static/images/ and static/external_cache/ with byte length, SHA-256 and the real upstream source URL for each; verified by scripts/check_asset_inventory.py at build time.
Real Allura project icons fetched from a.fsdn.com/allura/p/<shortname>/icon.
Real Allura project screenshots fetched from a.fsdn.com/allura/p/<shortname>/screenshot/<file>, resized to <=800px JPEG.

Real SourceForge sandiego-theme chrome assets (logos, favicons, leadership photos, business product logos, headquarters photo, avatars, social icons) fetched from a.fsdn.com/con/... as referenced by the captured pages.

The real upstream CSS suite (sandiego.css, lato.css, forge.css, font-awesome.min.css, tracker/ticket-list/wiki/activity/cmp/top styles, Lato + FontAwesome fonts, CSS-referenced svg images) fetched from a.fsdn.com/con/ with URLs rewritten to the local tree, plus a small vanilla site.js for nav dropdowns.

Jinja templates reproducing the captured upstream page structures and class names (sandiego chrome, directory cards, project pages, trackers, forums, reviews, stats, software directory, account pages, 404).

21 goal-style evaluation tasks (web_name/id/ques/web/upstream_url keys only) covering directory search, facets, project facts, files/versions, reviews, trackers, forums, stats, top lists, business software, accounts/bookmarks/reviews, registration, profiles, wiki/news.

23-test pytest self-check suite running against a temporary copy of the seeded database: core pages, search/facets, project facts, files/latest download, reviews histogram, trackers and ticket detail, CVE search, forums, top tables, stats, wiki/news, business software, about/leadership, profiles, auth flows (login with email, register validation, profile edit), data integrity, 404, and icon file presence.
